name: orch-apps
title: Apps
description: Publish a ticket's web page as a share and run mini apps on your orch-apps host, from Mission Control.

settings_schema.label: Server name to show (the orch-apps CLI's own setup decides where it deploys)
Domain for links (empty: the one orch-apps setup chose)

actions.label: Show link once
actions.confirm: Show the link now? It is shown once; copy it before you leave the page.

actions.label: Revoke share
actions.confirm: Revoke this share? Its link stops working at once.

actions.label: Stop app
actions.confirm: Stop this app? Its address answers that it is stopped until you start it again.

actions.label: Delete app
actions.confirm: Delete this app? It stops, its address goes away and its data moves to the server's archive.
